verdict.rationale: The only versioning evidence is the exceptions endpoint path https://api.honeybadger.io/v1/notices, which shows a version segment in the URL. Nothing in the pack describes a versioning scheme, compatibility guarantees, or a deprecation policy, so this is a single thin signal covering only half the story. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy or sunset timelines, a documented API versioning and compatibility policy, and changelog notices of version deprecations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Your JSON payload should be submitted as the body of a POST request to https://api.honeybadger.io/v1/notices
